annotations.title: Auspicious windows (muhūrta) in a date range

description:
Use this when the user asks for an auspicious date or time (muhūrta) to do something, such as a wedding, launch, move or purchase, within a date range at a given place.
Scans each day in the range and ranks windows for the subject. The pañcāṅga is computed for `eventPlace`, never defaulted to the birthplace.
Cost: 10 credits per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Deterministic: the same input always gives the same answer.
Example arguments: {"subject":{"date":"1990-05-12","time":"14:35","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209},"eventPlace":{"latitude":19.076,"longitude":72.8777,"timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","label":"Mumbai"},"freeText":"signing a lease","rangeStart":"2026-11-01","rangeEnd":"2026-11-15"}

eventPlace.description: Where the event will happen: latitude, longitude and IANA timezone. The pañcāṅga is computed here, never at the birthplace.

freeText.description: The event described in words, when there is no eventId.

subject.description: Birth data of the person the event is for; windows are ranked against their chart.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, local to `timezone`. Omit if unknown: house-dependent detail is then reduced.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

subjectName.description: Optional name of the subject, used only in the response text.

timeOfDay.description: Local time (HH:MM) at which each day is evaluated. Default: local sunrise.

topN.description: How many ranked windows to return. Default 5.

name: find_muhurta

requestId.description: Quote this in any support request.

sandbox.description: Present and true only on sandbox-key responses: a fixed sample, not computed from your request.

classicalSources.description: Titles of the muhūrta texts consulted. Titles only.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.
